name: slider-gate-v1
simplifications: 2D cross-section model: pill height projected onto the singulation plane; justified because singulation is governed by transverse width vs passage clearance.
Coulomb friction with a single per-pill coefficient; justified because reservoir wall contact is brief and coated/uncoated tablets are bracketed by the mu range 0.2-0.6.
Gravity-fed reservoir with random presentation order; justified because the hopper agitation between actuations decorrelates pill order.
